label: Читающий
description: A 10-sentence card for читающий, the present active participle of читать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Читающий comes from читать — the present stem читаj- of читают plus -щ- and an adjective ending. Here it agrees with masculine singular nominative мальчик and means the boy who is reading.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The participle takes the feminine ending -ая to agree with девочка. Читающая девочка equals девочка, которая читает — the girl who is reading right now.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Читающее carries the neuter ending -ее to match the neuter noun дитя. The participle describes the child who is currently absorbed in reading.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ие lets читающие agree with студенты. It picks out the students who are reading and therefore staying quiet.

missions.phrase: Я вижу читающего мальчика в парке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the animate masculine object мальчика the participle takes -его, so читающего matches it in gender, number and case as the thing I see.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Читающей takes the feminine genitive ending to agree with девочки, marking whose book it is — the book of the girl who is reading.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative object ученику pulls читающему into the dative -ему ending. The participle names the pupil who is reading and getting help.

missions.phrase: Я горжусь читающей внучкой каждый день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental. After горжусь the noun внучкой stands in the instrumental, and читающей takes the matching feminine instrumental ending to agree with it.
Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so both соседе and читающем take prepositional endings and agree as the neighbour we speak about.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative paraphrase. Читающие люди can be unfolded as люди, которые читают — people who read. The participle compresses that который-clause into one agreeing word.
